Porogaramu yashizwe kuri iyi buto (%1$s) ntabwo yashyizweho
%1$s gutangira / guhagarika umugambi wa auth token (andika umurongo wuzuye ‘auth: XXXX’ uhereye kuri%1$s’s View intents ecran)
Tanga%1$s uruhushya, hanyuma ushoboze iyi serivisi munsi ya Accessibility
Ikirangantego cya TV (kigira ingaruka kuri%1$s ya TV)
